additionalProperties.comment: Import the PreEfi HOB memory map, initialize DXE services, dispatch drivers, then invoke the Bds protocol. Companion hooks pause after the map import and before Bds selection.
additionalProperties.name: InitializeDxeDriverDispatch

additionalProperties.comment: Allocate pages by allocation policy and memory type. The address argument is a 64-bit input/output value; policy 2 requests a fixed aligned address.
additionalProperties.name: AllocateDxeMemoryPages

additionalProperties.comment: Write 48-byte memory descriptors and return the map key, descriptor stride and version 1. Update the required byte count when the supplied buffer is too small.
additionalProperties.name: GetDxeMemoryMap
